A [[human]] [[Gender|female]] '''ingenue''' attended a party held by [[Imperial Senate|Imperial Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] at the [[Chandrilan Embassy]] on [[Coruscant]]<ref name="Narkina5" /> in [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]" takes place shortly after "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," which dates itself to [[5 BBY]].</ref> She was in a conversation with an older senator and Mothma's [[Marriage|husband]] [[Perrin Fertha]]. She was complimenting her host's view of [[Imperial City]] and wondered how often Mothma and Fertha stood gazing from the building's [[Viewport|windows]] as Mothma joined the conversation.<ref name="Narkina5" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character appeared in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," the eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the TV series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''''<ref name="Narkina5" />'' which aired on [[October 26]], [[2022]],<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> where they were portrayed by [[Chelsea Edge]]. The character was only credited as an "Ingenue".''<ref name="Narkina5" />''
